name: Computer
description: Verified ZenX downstream UIA client with automatic focus disabled. Exact native controls support single semantic actions without requested activation; the target application may still change focus itself. Strict capture never restores or activates windows.
mainDocument: If available, start with computer_list_windows; its query filters windows only. Otherwise use the supplied exact window target. Prefer a returned exact window ref with computer_inspect; providers without discovery accept an explicit native window target. Inspect coverage and follow nextCursor alone to read the immutable captured controls beyond the first page; native traversal omissions remain explicit and are not recoverable by paging. References express exact-fingerprint presentation continuity, not proven native object identity. Actions use exact control refs and native revalidation. Pass since with a retained observation ref for a diff; omit since or set full:true after context compaction/lost context. For retained controls, pass the control ref with an explicit latest observation ref; native action checks still decide freshness. Cursor pages do not replace the first-page diff baseline or renew action authority. Discard prior continuation pages on every new observation or first-page diff and follow its new nextCursor for tails. Prefer background-safe semantic controls.

permissions.title: Inspect a targeted app
permissions.description: Read a bounded accessibility tree for an explicitly targeted app or window.

permissions.title: Act on a targeted control
permissions.description: Invoke or set a value through Windows UI Automation on an explicitly selected control.

permissions.title: Capture a targeted window
permissions.description: Capture one explicitly targeted HWND without restoring or activating it. Unavailable background frames fail closed.

tools.name: computer_environment
tools.description: Read the current desktop session and power availability. lockedTools names this provider’s scoped capabilities while locked; re-inspect for fresh controls and treat native failures as failures. Only explicitly listed native scoped tools may work while locked; foreground input requires an active session. This read does not wake, unlock, or operate another app.

tools.name: computer_list_windows
tools.description: List up to 32 open desktop windows and their running applications without activating them. Pass a case-insensitive query matching application name, PID, or title to narrow truncated results. Use its returned window ref with computer_inspect; this is not a catalog of installed apps.

tools.name: computer_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a bounded first page of at most 32 controls in one exact app window, or follow nextCursor without recapture. Coverage separately reports available pages and native omissions; this is not a complete accessibility tree. Model callers use since with an exact observation ref to request a diff; omit it or set full:true to resync. target.windowTitle is required. Windows reads are scoped to one exact HWND through UI Automation.

cursor.description: Continue the exact immutable captured observation using its returned nextCursor. Does not recapture or renew action references. Omit to inspect afresh.

baseObservationId.description: Request a diff only when you still retain that observation's full first-page baseline (or have applied its diffs). Omit after context compaction or lost context to receive a self-contained full view.

full.description: Force a new self-contained full bounded view. This does not mean the entire page/window was captured; follow nextCursor and inspect coverage.

tools.name: computer_press
tools.description: Invoke once on one freshly observed, uniquely identified native HWND control using the verified downstream UIA client with AutoSetFocus=false. No selector, other-pattern, activation or global-input fallback. Virtual and stale controls are refused. The target application itself can still change focus; interruption after possible dispatch has an unknown outcome and must not be retried automatically.

tools.name: computer_set_value
tools.description: Set and verify the exact supplied text on one freshly observed, uniquely identified native HWND control using the verified downstream UIA client with AutoSetFocus=false. No selector, other-pattern, activation or global-input fallback. Virtual and stale controls are refused. A completed action reports exact immediate ValuePattern readback match without echoing the text; application save or submit remains unverified. The target application itself can still change focus; interruption after possible dispatch has an unknown outcome and must not be retried automatically.

tools.name: computer_screenshot
tools.description: Capture one exact Windows HWND through a strict background PrintWindow helper. Minimized, hidden, protected or blank windows fail without activation. Returns private five-minute PNG metadata/path, never pixels in the Thread journal.
